policies.title: Tongan ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's current Embassy-linked nationality schedule places Tonga in its no-visa-required visitor cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Tongan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The waiver concerns the visa requirement; ordinary visitor admission conditions and final border discretion remain.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document cases are outside scope.

policies.title: Tongan ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official tourism nationality table marks Tonga eligible to obtain a visitor visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Tongan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
All non-Jordanians must register on Gateway2Jordan and obtain a QR code before departure.
The table states a 40 JOD arrival-visa charge; final admission remains discretionary.

policies.title: Tongan ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule places Tonga in its no-visa-required visitor cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Tongan passport holder travelling as a tourist for up to the published three-month maximum.
Passport validity, onward-travel, economic-solvency and final admission requirements remain.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document cases are outside scope.
